title: DirInputSpec
description: DirInputSpec is the input specification for the DirInput transformation.

compress.description: Compress indicates whether the resulting blob should be compressed with gzip.

excludeFiles.description: ExcludeFiles is a list of file name patterns to exclude from addition to the resulting blob.

followSymlinks.description: FollowSymlinks will include the content of the encountered symbolic links to the resulting blob.

includeFiles.description: IncludeFiles is a list of file name patterns to exclusively add to the resulting blob.

mediaType.description:
MediaType is the optional media type of the resulting blob.
If not set, it defaults to application/x-tar.

outputPath.description:
OutputPath is the optional directory path to buffer the blob file.
If empty, a temporary file will be created.

path.description: Path is the path to the directory on the local filesystem.

preserveDir.description: PreserveDir defines that the directory specified in the Path field should be included in the resulting blob.

reproducible.description: Reproducible defines that the attributes of the included files have to be normalized.

workingDirectory.description: WorkingDirectory is the base directory for resolving relative paths.
